extract_symbols_from_library: run sym_extract.py on a shared library to extract and output its list of symbols
extract_symbols_to_file: run sym_extract.py with the -o flag to write extracted symbols to an output file
extract_names_only: run sym_extract.py with --names-only to output only symbol names without additional metadata
filter_stdlib_symbols: run sym_extract.py with --only-stdlib-symbols to filter and output only stdlib-related symbols
review_main_function: review the main function that parses CLI args and orchestrates symbol extraction from a shared library
